record.question: Answer any 1 (one) of the following: (a) What do you meant by 'Daily Allowance'? Mention the admissibility of daily allowance in the following cases: (i) Absence not exceeding 6 hours (ii) Absence exceeding 6 hours but not exceeding 12 hours (iii) Absence exceeding 12 hours (b) What do you meant by 'Daily Allowance'? Mention the admissibility of daily allowance to Govt. servants deputed to undergo a course of training in India. (i) When boarding and lodging facilities are not provided. (ii) When boarding and lodging facilities exist. (iii) When boarding and lodging at the training institute are compulsory and are provided at fixed rates.
